{{Quote|To be proper, we would ride boliphants here through incense clouds.|Phi-Ton|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Boliphants''' were creatures native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] that were used by the native [[Voss (species)|Voss]] in their [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] ceremonies. The participants would ride boliphants through incense clouds to the site of the wedding.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1stm}}
